🎫 ScratchCard

A virtual scratch card: coins or symbols are hidden beneath a scratchable surface. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Click and drag across the scratch card surface to reveal hidden symbols.
  2. Match the required combination of symbols to win.
  3. Each card shows the prize value for different matching combinations.
  4. Reveal all areas or click 'Auto-scratch' to finish quickly.
  5. Buy another card or try a different card type to keep playing.
